title: Flow Detail Lod Channel Pick
description: At detail LOD, input/output channel rows should be selectable and hoverable instead of the complete node body.
summary: At detail and micro LOD, computation nodes no longer pick/hover/select as a whole rectangle. Input and output channel rows use full-column hitboxes (mirroring normal LOD input rows), node body hits are excluded via `node_body_hit_excluded`, and per-row highlight paint plus emphasized row dividers follow handle hover/selection. Parent widget id is reported when a channel handle is hovered so flow chrome still resolves context.
